verdict.rationale: Algolia documents Rules that override relevance 'in some situations' (e.g. seasonal promotions) and can make temporary changes to results, such as repositioning products. Separately, its ingestion connectors run on Algolia-managed schedules with retries and transformations, configured without code. Together these are a narrow, search-scoped form of rule-driven automation, not general event-triggered actions. Missing for 10: explicit condition/trigger definitions on events, webhooks or event-driven actions beyond search-result modification, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
